contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ (IMP C VICTORINVS P F AVG)

Copper alloy Roman radiate copy of Victorinus dating 269-71AD. Obverse legend: (IMP C VICTORINVS P F AVG). The reverse shows Sol running left, and the legend will have been [INVICTVS]. RIC 5 (Victorinus), 112 etc of AD 269-71. The diameter is 25mm and the weight is 1.73
